name: University of Jyväskylä
summary: University in Jyväskylä, central Finland; three English bachelor's: sustainable business, project-based software and AI, and early childhood.

handoff.label: How to apply for international bachelor's

ib.text: Everyone must prove English, with no waivers: an IB Diploma completed in English, English A, or English B at 5 counts. Selection rules differ by programme and are in the Studyinfo criteria.

dates.label: IB predicted grades due on Studyinfo (time to be announced)
Official final IB grades due, and deadline to accept your place

programmes.name: Business Innovation and Sustainability
programmes.ib: Certificate-based admission (group I) on IB grades; results by 28 May 2027.

programmes.name: Immersive Software Engineering and AI
programmes.ib: Online admission test, 10–11 February 2027, then online interviews, 17–24 March 2027.

notes: Early Childhood Education is functionally bilingual: taught in English with Finnish built in, and it qualifies you to work as an early childhood teacher in Finland.
Immersive Software Engineering and AI replaces lectures with project work and includes two four-month company internships.
Programme-specific admission criteria for 2027 were not yet public on Studyinfo on 25 September 2026.
